role: SwiftUI 'Get Me Back' safety screen: shows a compass arrow pointing back to the active breadcrumb trail's origin (bearing minus true heading), an honest GPS-accuracy ribbon, distance/origin label, Talk-to-AI, SOS dialing of a location-chosen emergency number, and end/discard trail actions; plus static emergency-number helpers reused by the assistant.
types: GetMeBackView: struct (View) — the Get Me Back screen, presented as a sheet from FitnessTabView+Sections.swift:41
GetMeBackView: extension — static emergency-number selection and SOS/dial-failure message text (also used by AppFactResolver+LiveNavigation.swift:402-406)
CompassArrow: struct (private View) — filled arrow path with blur glow scaled by fuzz
CardinalLabel: struct (private View) — one N/E/S/W letter offset 110pt and rotated around the dial
AccuracyState: enum (private) — UI mirror of GPSAccuracyLevel giving color/icon/opacity/fuzz/label
toplevel: @State initializers read UIScreen.main.brightness on every struct construction (60-61) and call GetMeBackView.emergencyNumber(currentCountry:nil) (44), which reads Locale.current.region. Environment: dependencies, dismiss, accessibilityReduceMotion. AccuracyState is Equatable by synthesis (compared with == at 447/449/482). File-level header comment (5-31) states arrow hides above 100 m and the view is offline-first.

flags.text: Private AccuracyState re-encodes GPSAccuracyLevel case-for-case (init is a 1:1 switch) and adds UI properties; GPSAccuracyLevel.swift:6-8 says the logic was moved out of the view precisely because a private enum here is untestable, yet color/icon/opacity/fuzz/label remain private and untested here.

units.does: Returns the BreadcrumbRecorder from the environment's AppDependencies location services (BreadcrumbRecorder.shared unless overridden).
True when the recorder's published CLAuthorizationStatus is .denied or .restricted; drives the location-denied banner.

branches.effect: returns false → no banner (notDetermined also shows no banner)

units.does: Returns recorder.activeTrail (the in-memory active BreadcrumbTrail or nil).
Returns the active trail's origin fix (first fix) or nil.
Returns recorder.latestLocation (latest CLLocation the recorder saw).
Returns recorder.latestHeading (latest CLHeading).
Country code of the ambient RoadGeocodingService's current reverse geocode if it was made within 5 km of the latest fix, else nil.

flags.text: Comment says the ambient service keeps the reverse geocode current 'while this screen is open', but ambient location is started only in onAppear (314-318) and stopped on every background transition (EmuquApp.swift:444); on return to foreground it restarts only when onboarding is done and the AI assistant is enabled (EmuquApp.swift:501-504), and onAppear does not re-fire for a sheet that stayed open. The geocode then goes stale and, once the user is >5 km away, SOS falls back to the Region rule (112/911) instead of the local number.

units.does: Emergency number for the current country (or region-derived fallback) via emergencyNumber(currentCountry:).
Straight-line distance in meters from latest location to the trail origin; nil if either missing.

branches.effect: true: returns CLLocation.distance; false: returns nil

units.does: Initial great-circle bearing (deg, north=0) from latest location to origin; nil if either missing.

branches.cond: latest coordinate and origin coordinate both present

units.does: True when a latest heading exists with trueHeading >= 0 and headingAccuracy >= 0.

branches.effect: false: returns false; true: returns trueHeading>=0 && headingAccuracy>=0 (trueHeading is -1 when CoreLocation lacks a location to compute true north, so heading is also invalid then)

units.does: Arrow rotation = bearingToOrigin − trueHeading normalized to (-180,180]; 0 when bearing, valid heading or heading missing.

branches.cond: bearing exists, heading valid, trueHeading available
branches.effect: false: returns 0 (arrow straight up); true: computes normalized difference
true: returns mod−360 (negative = left); false: returns mod

units.does: Latest fix's horizontalAccuracy, nil without a fix.
Maps current accuracy through GPSAccuracyLevel.classify (good <10, ok <30, poor <100, else/negative/nil waiting) into AccuracyState.

flags.text: Accuracy is classified from recorder.latestLocation with no fix-age check; the recorder keeps the previous trail's last fix in memory across disengage/endAndArchive (BreadcrumbRecorder.swift:161-179 never reset latestLocation; only forgetAfterPurge does at :187), so a newly engaged trail shows the old fix's 'GPS strong (±Nm)' ribbon until its first fix arrives.

units.does: Headline string: 'No active trail', 'Waiting for origin fix…', 'Wait for a better GPS fix', the formatted distance to origin in the user's units, or an em dash.

branches.effect: returns 'Wait for a better GPS fix'

units.does: Attaches end-trail alert, AI disclaimer sheet, SOS confirm alert (Cancel / Call → dialEmergencyServices, message from sosConfirmMessage with sosDialNumber) and dial-failed alert.
Attaches 'End this trail?' alert with endTrailAlertActions and explanatory message.
Alert buttons: Keep going (no-op), End and save (recorder.endAndArchive + dismiss), Discard (recorder.clearTrail deletes trail from disk + dismiss).

flags.text: 'End and save' loses the trail when archive.json exists but cannot be read/decoded: archive() returns early without writing (BreadcrumbStore.swift:310) while archiveActive() unconditionally calls clear() next (:241-242), deleting active.json. The user chose 'save' and the trail is gone with only a debug log.

units.does: Adds onAppear → prepareScreenState and onDisappear → resetScreenState.

On appear: disables idle timer if the keep-screen-on setting is on, starts AmbientLocationService (may prompt for location), resumes a restored breadcrumb trail, and snapshots system brightness into state.

branches.effect: true: isIdleTimerDisabled=true; false: idle timer untouched

units.does: On disappear: unconditionally re-enables the idle timer and, if the slider changed brightness, restores the brightness captured at appear.

branches.effect: true: restores systemBrightnessAtAppear and clears flag; false: brightness untouched

flags.text: Clears the process-wide idle-timer flag unconditionally, while RecordView's keep-awake helpers explicitly avoid clearing a timer another flow holds; dismissing Get Me Back while RecordView holds keep-awake (retry/recovery fetch) re-enables auto-lock under it.

units.does: Decorative 240pt ring with four localized cardinal letters placed every 90°; hidden from VoiceOver.
Splits localized 'N E S W' into four letters; falls back to English letters if the translation doesn't yield exactly four.

Dial: rose ring + CompassArrow rotated by arrowRotationDegrees with accuracy opacity/fuzz; arrow hidden (opacity 0) when accuracy is waiting or heading invalid; overlays spinner or compass-unavailable note; accessibility label from arrowAccessibilityLabel.

branches.effect: true: arrow opacity 0; false: arrow visible (no check that a trail/origin exists)

flags.text: Arrow is shown fully opaque pointing straight up when there is no bearing: line 447 hides it only for .waiting accuracy or an invalid heading, and arrowRotationDegrees returns 0 without a bearing (133-136). Reachable on the second engage in one process: tapping Get Me Back calls engage() which creates a trail with origin nil (BreadcrumbRecorder.swift:123-130), while latestLocation/latestHeading from the previous trail are never cleared by disengage()/endAndArchive() (BreadcrumbRecorder.swift:161-179), so accuracy is not .waiting and heading is valid until the first new fix. Contradicts the comment at 443-444.

Arrow/spinner gating re-implements GPSAccuracyLevel.showsDirection (`accuracyState == .waiting`), so the tested predicate is used only by GPSAccuracyLevelTests and not by the screen it was extracted for.

units.does: Static initial great-circle bearing (atan2 forward azimuth) normalized to [0,360).

flags.text: Bearing formula has no test reference (grep of EmuquTests for GetMeBackView.bearing finds none); it alone determines the arrow direction on the safety screen.

Same atan2 forward-azimuth formula is implemented four more times: bearingDegrees(from:to:) on CLLocationCoordinate2D (RoadGeocodingSupport.swift:84), RoadAwarenessEngine.bearingDegrees (:709), SavedRouteStepBuilder.bearing (:365) and WorkoutGeometry.bearing on Route.Point (:74).

units.does: Static map from ISO region to emergency number: 911 US/CA/MX/AS/GU/PR/VI/PH, 999 GB/IE/HK, 000 AU, 111 NZ, 119 JP/KR/TW, 120 CN, 193 BR, otherwise 112.
